theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  apply IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity
  apply ChoiceBisim.choice
  assumption
  constructor
  · intro s1 s2 h; cases h; assumption
  · intro s1 s2 h μ s1' htr
    cases h
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst h htr
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
        · constructor
          apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr2, hr2⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst h htr
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr2
        · constructor
          apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst h htr
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · assumption
      · constructor
        apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
  constructor
  · intro s1 s2 h μ s2' htr
    cases h
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd h htr
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
        · constructor
          apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr1, hr1⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd h htr
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr1
        · constructor
          apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd h htr
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · assumption
      · constructor
        apply hbisim.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
